features.feature: Every in-scope Codex/Claude implementer, verification-intent compatibility, topology-critic, concept, quality, coverage, docs and delivery prompt carries lane-appropriate canonical rollout guidance and cannot become authority
Verifier-owned versioned rollout report derives aggregates and rejects caller verdict/aggregate fields
Real reproducible baseline/candidate cohort freezes every eligible member in a declared window, prevents caller cherry-picking, and contains at least three matched pairs (>=3 per arm)
Report receipt binds eligibility rule, complete frozen membership, source records, version, workspace hashes, cost, rounds, waivers, adapters and full-3x2 provenance
Docs-only, legacy and ordinary single-outcome controls measure zero supported false blocks without fabricated runtime proof
Real-consumer omission/forgery mutations including topology-only C2 deletion bite and restore a clean control

Flat promotion thresholds require zero false passes across every registered seeded defect, 100% supported omission detection, zero false blocks/mislabeled 3x1, nonpositive waiver delta and nonshrinking checks
Unknown, partial, unsupported, incomplete-campaign, membership-drift or disagreeing adapters/campaigns fail promotion deterministically
Opt-in enforce mechanically consumes the exact current signed PASS report receipt at CLI and lifecycle consumers
Enforcement requires genuine current three rounds across two independent supported hosts and degraded 3x1 is never authority
Missing, stale, tampered, failing or weakened report/quorum/threshold inputs fail closed at the real consumer with stable codes
Rollback changes blocking policy only and preserves reports, receipts, transitions, diagnostics and evidence history
Canonical Story 6 plan and CLI docs update only after executable cohort/enforcement/rollback proof, with exact measured results and commands
Selective per-Story/per-policy enforcement remains excluded until Wave 3A is implemented
features.excluded_by: Wave 3A is explicitly skipped for flat rollout and remains mandatory before selective applicability can be claimed.

features.feature: No second writable acceptance matrix, caller-authored rollout verdict, prompt claim or degraded host label becomes gate evidence

openQuestions.q: Will CHK-002 verificationIntent explicitly require the verifier to bind and test the eligibility rule, complete frozen membership, >=3 matched pairs/each arm, and rejection of an omitted eligible row or changed evaluation window?
openQuestions.evidence: plan.md CHK-002 now states the correct rule, but CHK-002 happy only binds sample identities and caller verdict/aggregates; its adversarial lane does not mutate membership omission/window drift. Plan prose alone cannot require DEV evidence for anti-cherry-pick behavior.
openQuestions.resolution: The dedicated verification-intent writer updated CHK-002 happy/adversarial so the signed report must bind the eligibility rule, evaluation window, complete frozen membership and at least three matched pairs per arm; eligible-row omission, ineligible injection, window/membership/order/digest drift and N below three all fail deterministically.

openQuestions.q: Will CHK-003 verificationIntent require overall false-pass rate 0 across every registered seeded defect and an incomplete-campaign/undetected-non-omission mutation, in addition to omission detection 100%?
openQuestions.evidence: plan.md CHK-003 now states the correct threshold, but CHK-003 happy/adversarial still enumerate omission detection, false blocks, N=2, 3x1, waivers and inventory without overall false-pass=0 or incomplete registered campaign coverage.
